verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST Public API (Enterprise-only, prose docs, API-key auth, no OpenAPI spec) and an MCP server, but no official SDK or client library in any language. A raw HTTP API is an adjacent building block, not an official SDK, so it earns no credit for this story. Official SDKs are a fair ask for a SaaS product like this, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
